Man Sentenced for $35 Million Ponzi Scheme Targeting Athletes

A man has been sentenced for orchestrating a $35 million Ponzi scheme that defrauded numerous individuals, including professional athletes. The scheme allegedly funneled funds into a single stock. Among the victims named is NFL player Travis Kelce. One report identified the mastermind of the scheme as an undocumented immigrant.
